task.title: How to link a location in the same/different topics?
task.shortdesc: This section is to demonstrate how DITA approaches linking to same/different locations in same/different topics.

taskbody.context: Choose the topic element that is capable of generating an reference ID. Without an ID in place, the rendering becomes impossible.

step.cmd: Create an ID to have the target location.
step.stepxmp: Most often, you will use <section> topic element.

step.cmd: Create a new reference ID to the topic.
